name: N97

Launch.Predecessor: Nokia N96, Nokia N79 (for N97 Mini), Nokia 8600 Luna, Nokia E90 Communicator
Launch.Successor: Nokia N8, Nokia C6-00 (for N97 Mini), Nokia N900, Nokia E7-00, Nokia 808 PureView, Nokia Lumia 920/1020

Network.Technology: HSDPA (3.5G), Quad band GSM / GPRS / EDGE GSM 850, GSM 900, GSM 1800, GSM 1900

Body.Dimensions: 117.2 × 55.3 × 15.9* mm, *18.25 mm at camera area for original (113 x 52.5 x 14.2 mm for mini)
Body.Weight: 150 g for original (138 g for mini)

Platform.Operating system: Symbian 9.4 with Nokia S60 Fifth Edition UI. Current firmware 22.0.110 (RM-505) / 22.1.112 (RM-506) / 22.2.110 (RM-507) / 12.0.110 (N97 mini)

Memory.Storage: 32 GB on-board (about 29.8 GB user available) for original, (8 GB for mini)
Memory.Card slot: microSD 16 GB max (16 GB Max MicroSDHC available in 2009)

Display.Display: 640×360 px (16:9 aspect ratio), 3.5 in for original (3.2 in for mini), sliding tilt TFT LCD, up to 16.7 million colours

Cameras.Rear camera: 5.0 megapixels , f/2.8 Carl Zeiss Tessar lens

Battery.Battery: BP-4L (1500 mAh, :Li-polymer) for original, (BL-4D 3.7 V 1200 mAh for mini)

Connectivity.Connectivity: WLAN 802.11b/g, USB 2.0, Bluetooth 2.0, TV-out (PAL/NTSC), FM transmitter only for original

key.os: Symbian 9.4 with Nokia S60 Fifth Edition UI. Current firmware 22.0.110 (RM-505) / 22.1.112 (RM-506) / 22.2.110 (RM-507) / 12.0.110 (N97 mini)
